record.label: Bounded D/J/I/K/M out-of-fold ensemble screen
record.summary: The verified 688-row aligned OOF screen tests fixed equal averaging, outer-fold-held subset selection, outer-fold-held nonnegative convex weights, and per-layer variants across D/J/I/K/M. The best valid held method is the nested global nonnegative convex blend at final MSE 3.221703035370728e-8, which misses the 3.107e-8 material gate. The deliberately nondeployable same-row span reaches only 3.2185739007529746e-8 globally and 3.1796003925380795e-8 even with 5,120 separately fitted per-unit coefficients; the shared hard row remains near 3.39e-7. The candidate errors are therefore too collinear for bounded output-space stacking to approach 1e-8. RESULT.json and FINAL_RECEIPT.json are frozen at SHA-256 0bb7770e7d497ad9cd86e9293958f0a46a55fa424410a83c97c2ba03407e4484 and 91c2777288a5fe2a63ce836df035dd783d7c050cc3eda46611cca966f7e84d5c.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for this bounded D/J/I/K/M output-space ensemble family because no outer-fold-held method materially beats 3.107e-8, the best held result is 3.221703035370728e-8, and the optimistic same-row per-unit oracle remains 3.1796003925380795e-8. No immediate ensemble successor is licensed.
